headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - 'Pursuant to Regulation 57 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby certify that our Company has made timely payment of interest amount in respect of…
detail: Updates - 'Pursuant to Regulation 57 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby certify that our Company has made timely payment of interest amount in respect of the Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued by our Company, through Public Issue, and listed on the Stock Exchanges'.
